route: Mounted cua-driver, background isolated Chrome, synthetic DOM clicks followed by independent state readback.
viewport: Desktop 871 CSS pixels wide and narrow approximately 484 CSS pixels. Requested 500px native window clamped to 627px; readback confirmed actual geometry.
findings: Timer was absent before Play, visible while running, and absent when recall was shown.
Hebrew text and English explanations were readable at the inspected widths.
Selecting an answer enabled Check; feedback appeared only after Check.
Vocabulary mother was hidden initially and revealed after selecting אמא.
limits: Representative native browser inspection; all 154 pages separately exercised in jsdom. No trusted physical pointer test, screen-reader test, source audio check or Guy linguistic acceptance.
